description: This file defines a ChatLog component for a TUI (Text User Interface) application. It manages chat message components, including user messages, assistant messages, system messages, tool executions, and inline messages. The class provides methods to add, update, clear, and manage various chat elements, including handling pending messages, streaming assistant responses, and tool interactions.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A component that manages and displays a chat log with various message types, including user, assistant, system, and tool messages. It handles message addition, updates, and overflow management, as well as interactions with inline messages and tools.

methods.name: dropComponentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a given component from internal maps and state.

methods.name: pruneOverflow
methods.description: Removes oldest children until the maximum component count is respected.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a component as a child and prunes overflow if needed.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages and state, with an option to preserve pending user messages.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Re-adds pending user messages to the chat if they are not already displayed.

methods.name: clearPendingUsers
methods.description: Removes all pending user messages.

methods.name: createSystemMessage
methods.description: Creates a system message container with formatted text.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending user message, which may later be finalized.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message from pending list after it is finalized.

methods.name: dropPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message without finalizing.

methods.name: hasPendingUser
methods.description: Checks if a pending user message exists for a given runId.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages with a provided history, removing matches.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the total number of pending user messages.

methods.name: resolveRunId
methods.description: Resolves a runId to a specific identifier, defaulting if none provided.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts a streaming assistant message.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an existing streaming assistant message.

methods.name: finalizeAssistant
methods.description: Finalizes a streaming assistant message.

methods.name: dropAssistant
methods.description: Drops a streaming assistant message.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays an inline message (BtwInlineMessage).

methods.name: dismissBtw
methods.description: Removes the inline message.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if an inline message is visible.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Starts a tool execution component.

methods.name: updateToolArgs
methods.description: Updates the arguments for an ongoing tool execution.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result of a tool execution, with optional partial/error indication.

methods.name: setToolsExpanded
methods.description: Sets the expanded/collapsed state of all tool components.
